verdict.rationale: There is a dedicated Prohibited Use Policy referenced in the API Terms of Service and safety-settings docs let developers configure content restrictions, and pricing pages describe commercial (pay-as-you-go/free-tier) terms. However, the evidence pack shows no explicit, plain-language data-handling/privacy commitments, and community reports describe confusing billing practices (no easy hard-cap, delayed alerts, surprise multi-thousand-dollar bills) that undercut clarity of commercial terms in practice. Missing for 10: explicit data-handling/privacy commitments in plain language, a consolidated plain-language policy summary, and resolution of the billing-clarity complaints from developers.
